// Prints TypeScript's `osq show <id> --json` output for each row of rust-show
// "Show JSON equals TypeScript's" and "Show JSON with git equals TypeScript's".
// Run from the repository root after `pnpm build`:
//   node print-json-goldens.mjs <fixture show-project> <golden folder>
// Each case makes a fresh scratch base folder holding `checkout`, a copy of the
// fixture with 003-running's `.run/running/1.pid` marker written (git ignores
// `.run/running/`), and an empty `home`. A case that sets `vcs` writes
// `osq.config.ts` with `vcs: { enabled: true, author: "osq <osq@example.com>" }`;
// the Rust test writes `osq.toml` with the same two keys under `[vcs]` instead.
// Its setup builds the git state with the git program: `git init -b main` in the
// checkout and commits by `osq <osq@example.com>`; a worktree setup adds the
// worktree `<base>/worktree`. The built CLI runs with the checkout as its working
// directory and `home` as HOME, and its stdout, with the base folder's path
// replaced by `<base>`, is written to <name>.json.
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';

const BIN = path.resolve('dist', 'cli', 'bin.js');
const [fixture, golden] = process.argv.slice(2);
const ARCHIVED = path.join('openspec', 'changes', 'archive', '010-archived');
const APPROVED = path.join('openspec', 'changes', '002-approved');
const GIT_ENV = {
  GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: 'osq',
  GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: 'osq@example.com',
  GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: 'osq',
  GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: 'osq@example.com',
};

function git(cwd, ...args) {
  const run = spawnSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8', env: { ...process.env, ...GIT_ENV } });
  if (run.status !== 0) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(' ')}: ${run.stderr}`);
}

function append(file, text) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  fs.appendFileSync(file, text);
}

// No git.
function none() {}

// Every file committed on main.
function landed(base) {
  const root = path.join(base, 'checkout');
  git(root, 'init', '-q', '-b', 'main');
  git(root, 'add', '-A');
  git(root, 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'all');
}

// main without the folder; the folder stays untracked and no branch holds it.
function noBranch(base) {
  const root = path.join(base, 'checkout');
  const keep = path.join(base, 'keep');
  fs.renameSync(path.join(root, ARCHIVED), keep);
  landed(base);
  fs.renameSync(keep, path.join(root, ARCHIVED));
}

// main without `folder`; the branch `osq/<name>` in `<base>/worktree` adds it and
// one line of src/alpha.ts, then main gains `moves` commits that each add one
// line to src/beta.ts.
function worktree(folder, moves) {
  return (base) => {
    const root = path.join(base, 'checkout');
    const wt = path.join(base, 'worktree');
    const keep = path.join(base, 'keep');
    fs.renameSync(path.join(root, folder), keep);
    landed(base);
    git(root, 'worktree', 'add', '-q', '-b', `osq/${path.basename(folder)}`, wt);
    fs.cpSync(keep, path.join(wt, folder), { recursive: true });
    fs.rmSync(keep, { recursive: true, force: true });
    append(path.join(wt, 'src', 'alpha.ts'), 'export const more = 2;\n');
    git(wt, 'add', '-A');
    git(wt, 'commit', '-q', '-m', `add ${path.basename(folder)}`);
    for (let n = 1; n <= moves; n++) {
      append(path.join(root, 'src', 'beta.ts'), `export const move${n} = ${n};\n`);
      git(root, 'commit', '-q', '-am', `move ${n}`);
    }
  };
}

// No git; the archived change's stream gains a sync and then a stop.
function syncStopped(base) {
  append(
    path.join(base, 'checkout', ARCHIVED, '.run', 'events', 'change.jsonl'),
    '{"type":"synced","timestamp":"2026-10-06T08:00:00.000Z","data":{"defaultBranch":"main","commits":2}}\n' +
      '{"type":"sync_stopped","timestamp":"2026-10-06T09:00:00.000Z","data":{"reason":"conflict","message":"src/alpha.ts conflicts\\nsecond line"}}\n',
  );
}

const cases = [
  { name: 'active-001', args: ['1'], setup: none, vcs: false },
  { name: 'approved-002', args: ['approved'], setup: none, vcs: false },
  { name: 'running-003', args: ['003'], setup: none, vcs: false },
  { name: 'dead-004', args: ['004-dead'], setup: none, vcs: false },
  { name: 'steering-005', args: ['5'], setup: none, vcs: false },
  { name: 'blocked-006', args: ['006'], setup: none, vcs: false },
  { name: 'unplanned-007', args: ['007'], setup: none, vcs: false },
  { name: 'archived-010', args: ['10'], setup: none, vcs: false },
  {
    name: 'archived-path-010',
    args: ['openspec/changes/archive/010-archived'],
    setup: none,
    vcs: false,
  },
  { name: 'rejected-011', args: ['011'], setup: none, vcs: false },
  { name: 'land-landed-010', args: ['10'], setup: landed, vcs: false },
  { name: 'land-no-branch-vcs-010', args: ['10'], setup: noBranch, vcs: true },
  { name: 'land-unmoved-010', args: ['10'], setup: worktree(ARCHIVED, 0), vcs: true },
  { name: 'land-two-commits-010', args: ['10'], setup: worktree(ARCHIVED, 2), vcs: true },
  { name: 'land-sync-stopped-010', args: ['10'], setup: syncStopped, vcs: false },
  { name: 'worktree-002', args: ['2'], setup: worktree(APPROVED, 1), vcs: true },
];

for (const c of cases) {
  const base = fs.realpathSync(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'osq-show-json-')));
  const root = path.join(base, 'checkout');
  const home = path.join(base, 'home');
  fs.mkdirSync(home);
  fs.cpSync(fixture, root, { recursive: true });
  const running = path.join(root, 'openspec', 'changes', '003-running', '.run', 'running');
  fs.mkdirSync(running, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(running, '1.pid'), '{"pid":4242,"startedAt":1759395600000}\n');
  if (c.vcs) {
    fs.writeFileSync(
      path.join(root, 'osq.config.ts'),
      'export default { vcs: { enabled: true, author: "osq <osq@example.com>" } };\n',
    );
  }
  c.setup(base);
  const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, [BIN, 'show', ...c.args, '--json'], {
    cwd: root,
    encoding: 'utf8',
    env: { ...process.env, NO_COLOR: '1', HOME: home },
  });
  if (run.status !== 0 || run.stderr !== '') {
    throw new Error(`${c.name}: exit ${run.status} ${run.stderr}`);
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(golden, `${c.name}.json`), run.stdout.split(base).join('<base>'));
  fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true });
}
